sync.title: Cloud Sync
sync.description: Sync collections, wishlist, trash, recharge records, preset data, and local images across devices.
sync.imageSyncTime: Local images are synced to a separate Image Gist. Last image sync: {time}.
sync.remoteCollectionDesc: Official collection entries recorded in the cloud.
sync.remoteWishlistDesc: Entries currently marked as wishlist in the cloud.
sync.remoteRechargeDesc: Total recharge records saved in the cloud.
sync.remoteEventsDesc: Total events saved in the cloud.
sync.remoteImagesDesc: Number of image files currently saved in the Image Gist.
sync.remoteTrashDesc: Number of deleted items retained in the cloud.
sync.uploadDesc: Sync collections, recharge records, events, and other data to the remote backend. If conflicts are found, you will be prompted to choose how to resolve them.
sync.pullDesc: Merge the latest remote data into this device without directly overwriting local collections.
sync.gistBackendDesc: Sync across devices via GitHub with end-to-end encryption and version history. Easy to set up.
sync.supabaseBackendDesc: Store data and images in your own Supabase project. Supports real-time sync but requires more setup.
sync.viewDataGistDesc: Open the current Gist page to check remote files, update times, and version history.
sync.viewImageGistDesc: Open the separate Image Gist to view synced local image files and update times.
sync.githubLoginDesc: Complete authorization via Device Flow. An access token will be saved for sync, feedback, and updates.
sync.manualTokenDesc: You can still manually save a Personal Access Token with gist scope as a fallback.
sync.clearConfigDesc: Remove the saved Token and Gist configuration on this device. Remote data on GitHub will not be deleted.
sync.switchBackendConfirm: Switch sync backend to {backend}? This may require reconfiguring connection settings.
sync.logsNote: Sync logs are grouped by file and phase. Image files are collapsed by default; tap a group title to expand.
sync.logEmpty: Once syncing starts, each file's read steps and duration will appear here.
sync.tokenDesc: A Personal Access Token with gist scope is required.
sync.pullConfirmDesc: After confirming the pull, this device will align with the remote state. Data deleted remotely will also be removed locally.
sync.conflictDesc: The remote contains data updated by another device. Both the local last sync time and local last modified time are shown below.
sync.conflictChoose: Choose which side's data to keep:
sync.noUploadNeeded: Data is up to date, no upload needed
sync.reuploaded: Re-uploaded based on current local data
sync.pleaseConfigFirst: Please configure the URL and Key first
sync.githubOAuthNotConfigured: GitHub OAuth Client ID is not configured. Please set VITE_GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID first.
sync.githubLoginDesc: Complete authorization using Device Flow. After success, the access token will be saved automatically and your GitHub account info will be synced.
sync.codeExpiredError: GitHub device code expired, please re-initiate login.
sync.fillCode: Please enter code {code} on the authorization page
sync.waitingForAuthStatus: Waiting for you to complete authorization on GitHub...
sync.cause.networkSuggestion: Please check your network connection and try again
sync.cause.rateLimitSuggestion: Too many requests, please try again later
sync.cause.authSuggestion: Authentication expired, please log in again
sync.cause.serverSuggestion: Cloud service error, please try again later
sync.cause.dataFormatSuggestion: Data format error, please contact the developer
sync.cause.unknownSuggestion: Unknown error, please try again later
